name: My Fake Marriage
source:
You work at a Publicity Firm that works with many high-profile, celebrity clients. As the president’s secretary, you have worked on numerous successful projects. A new and mysterious request comes in, asking for you to pretend to be the wife of a handsome celebrity!

The genius president of an IT company, Quentin… the extremely talented and famous author, Roland… the legendary actor, Taylor… You hear out all of their stories and want to help them all, but this is just the beginning of all your troubles.

What could they be worried about? What are they hiding?

[from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.fakemarriage]Google Play[/url]]
